title: Man Goes Absolutely Ballistic At The Airport
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On October 29th, 2023. Multiple officers were dispatched to a plane that had just landed in reference to a man who had been yelling and cursing at the flight attendants the whole flight. When the officers tried to speak to him, he originally gave a fake them, he was very uncooperative and refused to calm down , which alerted the entire airport. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
